name: Venture Co. Mine
summary: In Mulgore’s eastern cliffs, the Venture Co. Mine cuts into land the tauren refused to surrender. The goblin company digs for minerals without permission, threatening the plains’ natural balance.

sections.title: Unwanted Industry
sections.body: The Venture Company tunnels through Mulgore’s eastern mountain wall despite the tauren’s refusal to grant mining rights. Supervisor Fizsprocket directs the work. Three entrances serve the complex: a ground tunnel guarded by hired muscle, a cliffside overlook, and an upper passage that leads to a small lumber camp. Machines, smoke, and slag heaps scar land the tauren hold sacred.

sections.title: Expanding Ambitions
sections.body: The Venture Company plans to extend its work beyond mining. Mogul Razdunk and the company’s board urged Fizsprocket to begin large-scale timber harvesting, promising advanced goblin shredders to clear the rolling hills. Tauren Outrunners attacked and burned a company supply caravan near Stonebull Lake’s northern shore to delay the expansion. Salvagers soon went to recover its cargo. The tribes now target the mine’s supervisors directly.

faq.q: Why are goblins mining in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Venture Company wanted to extract minerals from Mulgore, but the tauren refused permission. The cartel disregarded their territorial claims and the land’s balance, sending workers and machines into the eastern cliffs to plunder the hills without authorization.

faq.q: Who is in charge of this mining site?
faq.answer: Supervisor Fizsprocket directs Venture Company operations in Mulgore from his post inside the main entrance. He takes orders from the company’s executive board and Mogul Razdunk.

faq.q: What happened to the supply caravan by the lake?
faq.answer: Tauren Outrunners ambushed and burned a Venture Company supply caravan near Stonebull Lake’s northern shore to stop machinery from reaching the mine. Goblin salvage teams soon searched the wreckage for the company’s goods.

faq.q: What else do the goblins plan to build here?
faq.answer: Beyond mining ore from the cliffs, the company plans to build a lumber mill and use shredders to clear Mulgore’s trees for profit.

angles.text: The mine insults the Earth Mother. Its soot, noise, and scars mark the ancestral valleys the tauren tribes have sworn to protect.
Past the mine tunnels and through the higher lumber clearing, Twizwick Sprocketgrind shares mechanical trade secrets away from corporate eyes.
